card.name: Words leading up to becoming pregnant
card.fires_on: Small linking words and verbs just before 'pregnant' or 'conceive', in text about trying to have a baby or infertility. Examples are 'trying to', 'able to', 'get', 'become' and 'but'.

modes.description: Linking words in descriptions of couples unable to become pregnant, or who later do.
